create_pipeline: create a Pipeline instance with a sequence of Operation objects for data processing
parse_pipeline: parse a Pipeline to group operations into JIT and non-JIT blocks
compile_ops: compile all operations in a Pipeline by calling generate_code on each
allocate_memory: allocate pinned memory buffers for a Pipeline given batch_size and batches_ahead parameters
allocate_query: allocate a single memory buffer for an AllocationQuery with torch or numpy dtype
